hits.title: House of Student Raises $2M for AI Student Housing Platform
hits.snippet: # India-Based PropTech Startup House of Student Raises $2M to Expand AI-Powered Platform Globally Gurugram-based student housing technology startup House of Student has raised $2 million in seed funding through a combination of equity and debt financing to expand its AI-powered global accommodation platform. The round was co-led by Saltwater Sutra and Nirmitsu Inspirational Ventures, with participation from Gautam Verlekar, Glen Fernandes, Richard McCallum, Ali Moosa, and existing investor Unilodgers. House of Student will use the fresh capital to strengthen its technology platform, expand its global inventory of student accommodation, develop additional AI capabilities, and enter more international education destinations. ... ## Expanding Global Housing Inventory The startup will also invest in its technology infrastructure as it scales operations across different countries and housing markets. ... ## Strengthening AI Capabilities With more than 2.5 million verified rooms already accessible through its network, the new seed financing will help the startup expand its global footprint while developing technology aimed at simplifying the experience of studying abroad.
